title: FALCON: A CROSS-MODAL EVALUATION DATASET FOR COMPREHENSIVE SAFETY PERCEPTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking the safety of multimodal models across thirteen categories of harm. These categories include 'Bias', 'Unethical Behavior' (defined as actions considered morally wrong or socially irresponsible), and 'Hate Speech' (defined as expressing hatred based on religion or other characteristics), making ethics and moral judgment central to the dataset's purpose.
